description: Where the units of a flow graph are, for every engine that records, diffs, merges or applies flow operations. The stored flow JSON keeps its shape; this file only says how to address it. Paths are lists of object keys; '*' matches any key. The editor keeps a byte-identical copy.

view_state.description: Keys never recorded, diffed, merged or compared. Saves still store them.

field_units.description: A template field is split into units, each written whole. 'value' keys are written together; each toggle is its own value; every other key that is not view state is the field's 'definition' unit.

whole_values.description: Node paths written whole, never recursed. Any other key below data.node that is not 'template', 'outputs' or view state is also written whole.

keyed_lists.description: Lists whose items are addressed by a selector instead of an index. 'key' is the path of the item's key inside the item (an integer is a list index there). Natural-key lists are ordered by the component and selected with {"key": ...}; tables are ordered by 'position' then 'id' and their rows are selected with {"id": ...}.
